nodes.label: Accounts & role-based access control
nodes.rationale: RBAC enforced on every API route — the UI only hides what you can't do; the backend is the authority.

nodes.label: First-run setup (/setup, IPAMBOX_PASSWORD[_FILE])
nodes.rationale: Prefer IPAMBOX_PASSWORD_FILE (e.g. a Docker secret) so the password never sits in env/compose files.

nodes.label: Sessions & brute-force protection
nodes.rationale: Two independent protections: 5-strike lockout per (user, IP) pair plus a per-IP credential-stuffing backstop that ignores username.

nodes.label: The four roles (Administrator/Operator/Contributor/Viewer)
nodes.rationale: Guardrails: the last administrator can't demote or delete themselves, and nobody can delete their own account.

nodes.label: Users & Roles console + Account & Security
nodes.rationale: Changing a user's role or password revokes all of their sessions immediately.
